about: Kingmaker (formerly Sol Ghost) = Solomon with no UI. scripts/import-solomon.mjs copies a TSS commit into solomon/ and removes what is listed here, so the same strip runs every time TSS moves and Ghost never drifts from Solomon's engines.

remove.app/: the React UI (the Machine board and every window surface)
remove.desktop/main.mjs: the Electron window shell (windows, tray, IPC, renderer wiring)
remove.CLAUDE.md: the window UI lock; it does not apply to a UI-less Solomon
remove..claude/: agent tooling for the TSS repo, not part of Solomon
remove..claude-plugin/: the TSS repo's Claude Code plugin marketplace, not part of Solomon
remove.plugins/: Claude Code plugins for the TSS repo (the Muse council drives the Ronin CRM), not part of Solomon

kingmakerOnly.about: Founder-layer (Kingmaker-side) material consolidated from ronininc/kingmaker-os on 2026-10-23 under the ruling 'kingmaker-os is just a title — put all the abilities within it into kingmaker-private, to be staged at the publish gate.' These paths are Kingmaker's alone: never copied from TSS, never part of Solomon; the Solomon build excludes them by absence, the same rule the LittleBrother split follows.
